COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 2491 of 2024
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Anand Kumar Pandey, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. B.S. Koranga, learned Brief Holder for the 
State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for and 
is granted four weeks’ time to file amendment 
application.
4. Let the amendment application be filed within 
four weeks.
5. List this matter in the second week of February, 
2025.
6. In the meantime, the State may explain why 
arrear of salary for the period commencing from 
19.04.2023 to 10.05.2024 has not been paid to the 
petitioner.
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 06.01.2025
PR
